formal_copy_diff_vs_pilot3.left_as_is: `ontology_status` and `card.status` still read DEVELOPMENT. They are provenance fields of the Pilot-3 build, are not rendered, and are superseded for the formal run by this record. Left untouched so the diff against the frozen source stays one line.

protocol_changelog: v1 = the built-in Pilot-1-era wording shipped with the formal page (no external ontology, no 拇指根部/虎口 rule, no Class-4 fist exclusion). v2 = the frozen Pilot-3 ontology, served to the formal pages: long-finger distal-phalanx rules unchanged, thumb judged at the thumb base and first web space, CLASS_1 vs CLASS_6 decided by the thumb base, CLASS_4 carrying a hard fist exclusion. The 396-item benchmark, its windows, centres, GT values, blind ids, duplicate structure and presentation orders are UNCHANGED.

frozen_benchmark.note: The freeze is bound to this exact benchmark. These hashes must still hold at the end of the formal run.

C.note: C inherits the frozen second-lane ORDER only. The page identity, storage namespace and export filename are C's; the scientific payload is not modified.

commitments.no_revision_from_formal_disagreement: No future formal A/C disagreement may be used to revise this ontology. Remaining ambiguity is accepted as genuine annotation uncertainty.
commitments.class4_diagnostic_only: CLASS_4 stays diagnostic-only, outside the primary five-class semantic endpoint, and is never pooled into it.
commitments.no_post_hoc_adjudication: A/C disagreements are never adjudicated after model outputs have been seen, and no decoder prediction may influence consensus. Any later adjudication study must be separately designed and model-blind.
commitments.no_forcing_disagreements: Disagreement items are never forced into a class, and UNKNOWN / AMBIGUOUS / UNJUDGEABLE are never merged into a target class.
commitments.model_blinding: No decoder output, probability, margin, support/OOD distance, VEMG2Pose prediction or model accuracy is inspected until BOTH annotators have finished all 396 items and their exports are frozen.
commitments.duplicates_excluded_from_semantics: The 36 hidden duplicates are used only for intra-rater reliability and never enter the downstream semantic accuracy.
